title: Pure Ragnaraika
summary: Pure Ragnaraika link-climbing and control deck, uniting Insect, Plant, and Reptile monsters under an aggressive banish-and-recycle engine. Main Deck monsters summon themselves by banishing or returning resources while Ragnaraika Link Monsters continuously recur from the GY by placing your monsters on the bottom of the Deck, culminating in high-link bosses like Ragnaraika Stag Sovereign and Ragnaraika Chain Coils.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Ragnaraika the Evil Seed: Premier starter that Special Summons itself by sending an Insect, Plant, or Reptile from hand to GY and searches two Ragnaraika cards with different Types.
Ragnaraika Samurai Beetle: Special Summons itself from hand by returning a banished monster to the Deck and revives an Insect, Plant, or Reptile when used as Link material.
Ragnaraika Armored Lizard: Extender Special Summoning itself from hand by banishing a monster from your GY and discarding to bounce an opposing monster.
Ragnaraika Bloom: Continuous Spell searching or reviving a Ragnaraika monster every single turn while debuffing opposing non-tri-type monsters.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Special Summon Ragnaraika the Evil Seed by sending an Insect, Plant, or Reptile from hand to GY.
Activate the Evil Seed to add Ragnaraika Samurai Beetle and Ragnaraika Armored Lizard from Deck to hand.
Link Summon Ragnaraika Skeletal Soldier using the Evil Seed and a monster on field.
Activate Ragnaraika Skeletal Soldier to Special Summon an Insect, Plant, or Reptile from your GY.
Climb into Link-3 Ragnaraika Mantis Monk, which searches Ragnaraika Hunting Dance or Ragnaraika Bloom.
Continue climbing into Link-4 Ragnaraika Chain Coils or Link-5 Ragnaraika Stag Sovereign.
Set Ragnaraika Hunting Dance to establish multi-card spot removal on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ragnaraika Stag Sovereign: Link-5 powerhouse that destroys up to two cards on the field whenever the opponent Special Summons from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Ragnaraika Chain Coils: Link-4 boss that prevents the opponent from activating monster effects in the hand for the rest of the turn.
Ragnaraika Mantis Monk & Ragnaraika Skeletal Soldier: Mid-link bridges that tutor archetype Traps, revive materials, and recur from the GY.
Ragnaraika Selene Snapper: Link-3 utility boss providing targeted Spell and Trap destruction.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ragnaraika Hunting Dance: Searchable Normal Trap destroying opposing cards up to the number of different monster Types (Insect, Plant, Reptile) among your Links, with GY re-destruction.
Ragnaraika Bloom: Continuous advantage engine providing turn-by-turn searches or revivals.
Ragnaraika Wisteria of Woe: Trap monster that banishes cards from the opponent's GY and resets itself to the field.
